desc:
Welcome to SURPG!

🌎 • Explore the map and all it's contents!
💎 • Collect the 7 Emeralds and transform!
👊 • Battle it out in PvP!
📜 • Complete Quests and unlock new abilities!
👕 • Show how unique you are with character customization!

• Like 👍 and favourite ⭐️ if you want to support us.

... And more coming soon!
